english_user: What to expect if I have Allergy (Outlook/Prognosis)?
faithful_english_meaning: What to expect if I have Allergy (Outlook/Prognosis)?
english_answer: Most allergies can be easily treated with medication. Some children may outgrow an allergy. This is particularly true of food allergies. However, as a general rule, once a substance has triggered an allergic reaction, it continues to affect the person. Allergy shots are most effective when used to treat those with hay fever symptoms and severe insect sting allergies. They are not used to treat food allergies because of the danger of a severe reaction. Allergy shots may require years of treatment, but they work in most cases. However, they may cause uncomfortable side effects (such as hives and rash) and dangerous outcomes (such as anaphylaxis).
twi_user: Sɛ mewɔ alɛgye a, daakye me tebea bɛyɛ dɛn?
twi_answer: Wobetumi de aduru asa alɛgye pii a ɛnyɛ den. Mmofra binom alɛgye tumi fi wɔn ho bere a wɔrenyin. Eyi taa ba titiriw wɔ aduan ho alɛgye mu. Nanso, sɛ ade bi kanyan obi alɛgye pɛn a, mpɛn pii no, ɛkɔ so nya onii no so nkɛntɛnso. Nnuru a wɔde pane gu nipadua mu de sa alɛgye no yɛ adwuma yiye ma wɔn a wɔwɔ hay fever ho nsɛnkyerɛnne ne wɔn a nkoekoemmoa nwowɔ ma wɔn alɛgye a emu yɛ den. Esiane alɛgye a emu yɛ den ho asiane nti, wɔmfa nnuru a wɔde pane gu nipadua mu yi nsa aduan ho alɛgye. Ebia ɛho behia sɛ wɔkɔ so de saa ayaresa yi ma mfe pii, nanso ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nnipa dodow no ara mu. Nanso, ebetumi de ɔhaw ahorow te sɛ honam ani ntɔkwa ne mpumpuru aba, na ebetumi nso de tebea a ɛyɛ hu te sɛ anafilaksis aba.

english_user: What are the symptoms of Anaphylaxis?
faithful_english_meaning: What are the symptoms of Anaphylaxis?
english_answer: Symptoms develop rapidly, often within seconds or minutes. They may include the following: Abdominal pain or cramping Abnormal (high-pitched) breathing sounds Anxiety Confusion Cough Diarrhea Difficulty breathing Difficulty swallowing Fainting, light-headedness, dizziness Hives, itchiness Nasal congestion Nausea, vomiting Palpitations Skin redness Slurred speech Wheezing
twi_answer: Nsɛnkyerɛnne no ba ntɛm, na mpɛn pii no, efi ase wɔ sikɔne anaa simma kakraa bi mu. Ebetumi ayɛ nea edidi so yi: yafunu mu yaw anaa yafunu a ɛkyekyere; ahome a ɛyɛ nnyigyei a ano yɛ den; dadwen anaa ahopopo; adwene a etu fra; ɔfe; ayamtu; ahome a ɛyɛ den; aduan anaa biribi mene a ɛyɛ den; twa a wɔtwa hwe, ani so a ɛyɛ hare, anaa ti a ɛkyinhyia; honam ani ntɔkwa ne nyɛwee; hwene mu a esi; ɔfe a ɛba ne fe; koma a ɛbɔ ntɛmntɛm anaa denneennen; honam ani a ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ; kasa a emu nna hɔ; ne ahome a ɛbɔ hwiridudu.

english_answer: Anaphylaxis is a severe, whole-body allergic reaction to a chemical that has become an allergen. After being exposed to a substance such as bee sting venom, the person's immune system becomes sensitized to it. On a later exposure to that allergen, an allergic reaction may occur. This reaction happens quickly after the exposure, is severe, and involves the whole body. Tissues in different parts of the body release histamine and other substances. This causes the airways to tighten and leads to other symptoms. Some drugs (morphine, x-ray dye, and others) may cause an anaphylactic-like reaction (anaphylactoid reaction) when people are first exposed to them. Aspirin may also cause a reaction. These reactions are not the same as the immune system response that occurs with "true" anaphylaxis. However, the symptoms, risk for complications, and treatment are the same for both types of reactions. Anaphylaxis can occur in response to any allergen. Common causes include: Drug allergies Food allergies Insect bites/stings Pollens and other inhaled allergens rarely cause anaphylaxis. Some people have an anaphylactic reaction with no known cause. Anaphylaxis is life-threatening and can occur at any time. Risks include a history of any type of allergic reaction.
twi_answer: Anafilaksis yɛ alɛgye a emu yɛ den a ɛka nipadua no nyinaa. Ade bi a nipadua no bu no sɛ ɔtamfo na ɛkanyan alɛgye no na ɛde ba. Sɛ ade bi te sɛ aṅwo bɔre ka obi ho a, onii no nipadua banbɔ nhyehyɛe no betumi asua ade no na ayɛ krado sɛ ɛbɛko atia no. Sɛ saa ade a ɛkanyan alɛgye no ka onii no ho bio akyiri yi a, alɛgye betumi aba. Ɛba ntɛm wɔ bere a ade no aka onii no ho akyi, emu yɛ den, na ɛka nipadua no nyinaa. Ntini ahorow a ɛwɔ nipadua no afã horow yi histamine ne nneɛma foforo adi. Eyi ma ahome akwan no kyekyere, na ɛde nsɛnkyerɛnne foforo ba. Nnuru bi te sɛ morphine, aduru a wɔde yɛ X-ray no mu adwini, ne nnuru foforo betumi ama obi anya tebea bi a ɛte sɛ anafilaksis bere a ɔde di dwuma nea edi kan. Wɔfrɛ eyi anaphylactoid reaction. Aspirin nso betumi de saa tebea yi aba. Saa tebea ahorow yi nyɛ ade koro ne nipadua banbɔ nhyehyɛe no mmuae a ɛba wɔ anafilaksis ankasa mu. Nanso, nsɛnkyerɛnne, ɔhaw a ebetumi afi mu aba, ne ayaresa yɛ pɛ wɔ tebea abien no nyinaa mu. Ade biara a etumi kanyan alɛgye betumi de anafilaksis aba. Nea ɛtaa de ba no bi ne nnuru ho alɛgye, aduan ho alɛgye, ne nkoekoemmoa ka anaa wɔn nwowɔ. Nhwiren mfutuma ne nneɛma foforo a wɔhome gu nipadua mu a ɛkanyan alɛgye no ntaa mfa anafilaksis mma. Nnipa binom nya anafilaksis a wonnim nea ɛde ba. Anafilaksis betumi akum obi, na ebetumi aba bere biara. Sɛ obi anya alɛgye bi pɛn a, ɛma n’asiane yɛ kɛse.

english_user: When to seek urgent medical care when I have Anaphylaxis ?
faithful_english_meaning: When to seek urgent medical care when I have Anaphylaxis ?
english_answer: Call 911 if you develop severe symptoms of anaphylaxis. If you are with another person, he or she may take you to the nearest emergency room.
twi_user: Sɛ mewɔ anaphylaxis a, bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mekɔhwehwɛ ayaresa ntɛm ara?
twi_answer: Sɛ anaphylaxis ho nsɛnkyerɛnne a emu yɛ den ba wo so a, frɛ 911. Sɛ obi ka wo ho a, obetumi de wo akɔ ayaresabea a wɔhwɛ tebea a egye ntɛmpɛ ho a ɛbɛn wo paa no.

english_user: What to expect if I have Anaphylaxis (Outlook/Prognosis)?
faithful_english_meaning: What to expect if I have Anaphylaxis (Outlook/Prognosis)?
english_answer: Anaphylaxis is a severe disorder that can be life-threatening without prompt treatment. However, symptoms usually get better with the right therapy, so it is important to act right away.
twi_user: Sɛ mewɔ anaphylaxis a, dɛn na metumi ahwɛ kwan wɔ ne nkɔso ne nea ebefi mu aba ho?
twi_answer: Anaphylaxis yɛ tebea a emu yɛ den, na sɛ wɔansa no ntɛm a, ebetumi de nkwa ato asiane mu. Nanso sɛ wɔde ayaresa a ɛfata sa a, mpɛn pii no ne ho nsɛnkyerɛnne no so tew. Enti ɛho hia sɛ wodi ho dwuma ntɛm ara.

english_user: What are the symptoms of Angioedema?
faithful_english_meaning: What are the symptoms of Angioedema?
english_answer: The main symptom is sudden swelling below the skin surface. You may also develop welts or swelling on the surface of your skin. The swelling usually occurs around the eyes and lips. It may also be found on the hands, feet, and throat. The swelling may form a line or be more spread out. The welts are painful and may be itchy. They turn pale and swell if irritated. The deeper swelling of angioedema may also be painful. Other symptoms may include: Abdominal cramping. Breathing difficulty. Swollen eyes and mouth. Swollen lining of the eyes (chemosis).
twi_answer: Nsɛnkyerɛnne titiriw ne sɛ honam no ase bɛhonhon mpofirim. Nkurukuruwa akɛse a ahonhon anaa ahonhon nso betumi aba honam no ani. Mpɛn pii no, ahonhon no ba aniwa ne ano ano ho. Ebetumi nso aba nsa, nan ne menewa mu. Ahonhon no betumi ayɛ sɛ nsensanee anaa atrɛw akɔ mmeae pii. Nkurukuruwa a ahonhon no yɛ yaw, na ebetumi nso ayɛ nyɛ. Sɛ biribi hyɛ no abufuw a, ɛyɛ fitaa na ɛhonhon. Angioedema ahonhon a ɛkɔ honam no mu tɔnn no nso betumi ayɛ yaw. Nsɛnkyerɛnne foforo bi ne: yafunu mu kyekyere; home a ɛyɛ den; aniwa ne ano a ahonhon; ne aniwa no mu nkataso a ahonhon (chemosis).

english_answer: Angioedema may be caused by an allergic reaction. During the reaction, histamine and other chemicals are released into the bloodstream. The body releases histamine when the immune system detects a foreign substance called an allergen. In many cases, the cause of angioedema is never found. The following may cause angioedema: Animal dander (scales of shed skin). Exposure to water, sunlight, cold or heat. Foods (such as berries, shellfish, fish, nuts, eggs, milk, and others). Insect bites. Medications (drug allergy), such as antibiotics (penicillin and sulfa drugs), nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), and blood pressure medicines (ACE inhibitors). Pollen. Hives and angioedema may also occur after infections or with other illnesses (including autoimmune disorders such as lupus, and leukemia and lymphoma). A form of angioedema runs in families and has different triggers, complications, and treatments. This is called hereditary angioedema, and it is not discussed in this article.
twi_answer: Biribi a nipadua no mpɛ ho betumi ama angioedema aba. Saa tebea yi mu no, histamine ne nnuru foforo fi adi kɔ mogya no mu. Sɛ nipadua no ho banbɔ nhyehyɛe no hu ade foforo bi a wɔfrɛ no allergen a, nipadua no yi histamine adi. Mpɛn pii no, wonhu nea ɛde angioedema no ba. Nneɛma a edidi so yi betumi de angioedema aba: mmoa ho were nketenkete a ahwe; nsu, owia, awɔw anaa ɔhyew a ɛka nipadua; nnuan te sɛ berries, nsunam a wɔwɔ akorade mu, mpataa, nnuaba aba, nkesua, nufusu ne afoforo; nkoekoemmoa a wɔka obi; nnuru a nipadua no mpɛ, te sɛ antibiotics (penicillin ne sulfa nnuru), nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), ne mogya mmoroso nnuru (ACE inhibitors); ne nhwiren mfutuma. Hives ne angioedema nso betumi aba ɔyare mmoawa bi akyi anaa ayare afoforo nti. Eyinom bi ne autoimmune yare te sɛ lupus, leukemia ne lymphoma. Angioedema bi wɔ hɔ a ɛnam abusua mu, na nneɛma a ɛkanyan no, ɔhaw ahorow a ebetumi de aba, ne ne ayaresa yɛ soronko. Wɔfrɛ eyi hereditary angioedema, na wɔankasa ho asɛm wɔ asɛm yi mu.

english_user: When to seek urgent medical care when I have Angioedema ?
faithful_english_meaning: When to seek urgent medical care when I have Angioedema ?
english_answer: Call your health care provider if: Angioedema does not respond to treatment It is severe You have never had angioedema before Go to the emergency room or call the local emergency number (such as 911) if you have: Abnormal breathing sounds (stridor) Difficulty breathing Fainting Wheezing
twi_user: Sɛ mewɔ angioedema a, bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ ayaresa ntɛm?
twi_answer: Frɛ wo dɔkota anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛfo no sɛ: ayaresa no nyɛ angioedema no yiye; emu yɛ den; anaa wonnyaa angioedema da. Kɔ ayaresabea fã a wɔhwɛ ayarefo a wɔn tebea gye ntɛmpɛ no ntɛm ara, anaa frɛ mpɔtam hɔ ntɛmpɛ mmoa nɔma te sɛ 911, sɛ: wote ahome a ɛyɛ dede a ɛnyɛ ne kwan so (stridor); ɛyɛ den ma wo sɛ wobɛhome; wo tɔ beraw; anaa wohome a, wo koko mu si hwirema.

english_user: What to expect if I have Angioedema (Outlook/Prognosis)?
faithful_english_meaning: What to expect if I have Angioedema (Outlook/Prognosis)?
english_answer: Angioedema that does not affect the breathing may be uncomfortable, but is usually harmless and goes away in a few days.
twi_user: Sɛ mewɔ angioedema a, dɛn na metumi ahwɛ kwan wɔ ne nkɔso ho?
twi_answer: Sɛ angioedema no nka ahome a, ebetumi ama wo ho ayɛ wo ahi, nanso mpɛn pii no, ɛnyɛ hu na ɛno ara fi hɔ wɔ nna kakra mu.

english_user: What are the symptoms of Allergy?
faithful_english_meaning: What are the symptoms of Allergy?
english_answer: Allergy symptoms vary, but may include: Breathing problems (coughing, shortness of breath) Burning, tearing, or itchy eyes Conjunctivitis (red, swollen eyes) Coughing Diarrhea Headache Hives Itching of the nose, mouth, throat, skin, or any other area Runny nose Skin rashes Stomach cramps Vomiting Wheezing What part of the body is contacted by the allergen plays a role in the symptoms you develop. For example: Allergens that are breathed in often cause a stuffy nose, itchy nose and throat, mucus production, cough, or wheezing. Allergens that touch the eyes may cause itchy, watery, red, swollen eyes. Eating something you are allergic to can cause nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, cramping, diarrhea, or a severe, life-threatening reaction. Allergens that touch the skin can cause a skin rash, hives, itching, blisters, or even skin peeling. Drug allergies usually involve the whole body and can lead to a variety of symptoms.
twi_answer: Allergy ho nsɛnkyerɛnne gu ahorow, na ebetumi ayɛ: ahomegu mu haw te sɛ ɔfe anaa ahome a ɛyɛ tia; aniwa mu hyew, aniwa a nusu fi mu, anaa aniwa a ɛkeka wo; aniwa mu ntama no a ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ na ɛhono; ɔfe; ayamtu; tiyaw; honam ani mpɔmpɔn; hwene, ano, menewa, honam anaa nipadua no fã foforo bi a ɛkeka wo; hwene mu nsu a ɛsen; honam ani ntwom; yafunu mu yaw anaa yafunu a ɛkyekyere; ɔfe; ne ahome a ɛbɔ hwirema. Nipadua no fã a ade a ɛkanyan allergy no ka no betumi akyerɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wubenya. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Sɛ wotwe ade a ɛkanyan allergy no gu wo mu a, mpɛn pii no ɛma hwene si, hwene ne menewa keka wo, hwene mu nsu dɔɔso, woafe, anaa ahome bɔ hwirema. Sɛ ɛka aniwa a, ebetumi ama aniwa akeka wo, nusu afi mu, ayɛ kɔkɔɔ na ahono. Sɛ wudi biribi a wowɔ allergy wɔ ho a, ebetumi ama wo bo ayɛ wo kusuu, woafe, wo yafunu mu ayɛ wo yaw anaa akyekyere wo, woanya ayamtu, anaa woanya tebea a emu yɛ den a ebetumi de wo nkwa ato asiane mu. Sɛ ade a ɛkanyan allergy no ka honam a, ebetumi ama honam ani atwom, ayɛ mpɔmpɔn, akeka wo, ayɛ nsu-nsu mpɔmpɔ, anaa honam ani were mpo. Nnuru ho allergy taa ka nipadua no nyinaa, na ebetumi de nsɛnkyerɛnne ahorow pii aba.

english_answer: The immune system normally protects the body against harmful substances, such as bacteria and viruses. It also reacts to foreign substances called allergens, which are generally harmless and in most people do not cause a problem.But in a person with allergies, the immune response is oversensitive. When it recognizes an allergen, it releases chemicals such as histamines. which fight off the allergen. This causes itching, swelling, mucus production, muscle spasms, hives, rashes, and other symptoms, which vary from person to person. Common allergens include pollen, mold, pet dander, and dust. Food and drug allergies are common. Allergic reactions can also be caused by insect bites, jewelry, cosmetics, spices, and other substances.Some people have allergy-like reactions to hot or cold temperatures, sunlight, or other environmental triggers. Sometimes, friction (rubbing or roughly stroking the skin) will cause symptoms.A specific allergy is not usually passed down through families (inherited). However, if both your parents have allergies, you are likely to have allergies. The chance is greater if your mother has allergies. Allergies may make certain medical conditions such as sinus problems, eczema, and asthma worse.Allergies are relatively common. Both genetics and environmental factors play a role.
twi_answer:
Mpɛn pii no, nipadua no banbɔ nhyehyɛe bɔ nipadua no ho ban fi nneɛma bɔne te sɛ mmoawa ne virus ho. Ɛsan nso yɛ n’ade tia nneɛma foforo bi a wɔfrɛ no allergens, a mpɛn pii no ɛnyɛ bɔne na ɛnhaw nnipa dodow no ara.

Nanso, obi a ɔwɔ allergy de, ne nipadua banbɔ nhyehyɛe no yɛ n’ade tra so. Sɛ ehu allergen bi a, eyi nnuru bi te sɛ histamine adi de ko tia no. Eyi betumi ama ɔfe, ahonhon, dwonsɔ anaa nsu a ɛwɔ nipadua mu no ayɛ bebree, ntini atwetwe wɔn ho mpofirim, akisikuru a ɛbobɔ honam ani, honam ani ntɔe ne sɛnkyerɛnne afoforo. Saa sɛnkyerɛnne yi gu ahorow wɔ obiara mu.

Nneɛma a ɛtaa de allergy ba no bi ne nhwiren mfutuma, mmoawa a wɔfifiri nneɛma so, afieboa ho nhwi ne honam nketenkete, ne mfutuma. Aduan ne nnuru allergy nso abu so. Nkoekoemmoa bi ka, agude, ahosiesie nneɛma, aduhuam ne nneɛma afoforo nso betumi ama allergy ho sɛnkyerɛnne aba.

Nnipa binom nipadua yɛ n’ade te sɛ allergy bere a wɔahyia ɔhyew, awɔw, owia hann anaa nneɛma foforo a atwa wɔn ho ahyia. Ɛtɔ da bi nso a, sɛ biribi twetwe honam ani anaa wɔde ahoɔden mia so a, ebetumi de sɛnkyerɛnne no aba.

Mpɛn pii no, allergy pɔtee bi mfa abusua mu nkɔ awo ntoatoaso mu. Nanso, sɛ w’awofo baanu nyinaa wɔ allergy a, ɛda adi kɛse sɛ wo nso wubenya allergy. Hokwan no yɛ kɛse paa sɛ wo maame wɔ allergy. Allergy betumi ama yare te sɛ sinus haw, eczema ne asthma mu ayɛ den.

Allergy abu so kakra. Awosu mu nneɛma ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia nyinaa boa ma ɛba.

english_user: When to seek urgent medical care when I have Allergy ?
faithful_english_meaning: When to seek urgent medical care when I have Allergy ?
english_answer: Call for an appointment with your health care provider if: Severe symptoms of allergy occur. Treatment for allergies no longer works.
twi_user: Sɛ mewɔ alɛji a, bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mepɛ ayaresa ntɛm?
twi_answer: Frɛ wo dɔkota anaa akwahosan ho ɔhwɛfo no na yɛ nhyiam bere sɛ: Alɛji no ho nsɛnkyerɛnne a emu yɛ den ba, anaa alɛji no ho ayaresa no nyɛ adwuma bio.
